faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about AquaRO. Can't find your answer? Reach out to our team.
faq.q1: How does the free trial work?
faq.a1: You get full access to all Professional plan features for 14 days, no credit card required. At the end of the trial, choose a plan that fits your needs or your account will be paused.
faq.q2: Can I monitor multiple RO units from a single dashboard?
faq.a2: Absolutely. AquaRO is built for multi-unit, multi-station operations. You can monitor hundreds of RO units across unlimited geographic stations from a single unified dashboard.
faq.a3: Operators can submit readings through our mobile-friendly web interface. They log in, select their assigned unit, and input the daily parameters. The system validates the data in real-time against configured thresholds.
faq.q4: Does AquaRO integrate with automated sensors?
faq.a4: Yes. Our API supports integration with IoT sensors and automated monitoring equipment for real-time data ingestion without manual operator input.
faq.a5: Administrators can configure custom upper and lower thresholds for each parameter (TDS, pressure, pH, conductivity, etc.) per unit or station. When a reading exceeds a threshold, alerts are sent instantly.
faq.a6: Yes. All data is encrypted at rest and in transit. We use role-based access control to ensure users only see the data they're authorized to access. We perform regular security audits.
